briefdescription.para: C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ function comparators.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the declarations for the function comparator templates and logical operators used within the µTest++ framework. It defines the interfaces for the generic comparison functions, including equality, non-equality, greater than, less than, greater than or equal, and less than or equal, and the approximate comparison with an explicit tolerance (approx). Additionally, it declares logical combinators such as conjunction (all_of), disjunction (any_of), and negation (negate); their deprecated v5.0.1 names are declared in deprecated.h.

The C strings (the arrays, including the string literals, and the pointers of the character types) are compared by content, and so are the other arrays (e.g. byte buffers), element by element; the other pointers are compared by address. The temporaries are moved into the returned expressions, and the named operands are copied, so an expression can be returned from the function that builds it, and kept after the operands are destroyed, except for the arrays and the characters of the C strings, which are referred to and must outlive the expression. The copy is made for every check, passing or failing, so a large container or string costs an allocation; compare a std::string_view of a string instead, when the cost matters. The logical combinators have descriptive names, since and, or, and not are alternative tokens and cannot be used as identifiers.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus namespace.
This file is included by micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus.h, which is the header that the applications include.
